properties.evidence: The older thought, grown up. That decision settled THAT the ladder opens and was taken before any implementation existed; this asks whether the carrier chosen to open it — a declared rung NAME per component — is the right shape, and it can only be asked now because there is something concrete to criticise. Its sharpest point is that the shipped design asserts ONE LADDER PER DESIGN, which is the same domain-uniformity assumption the parent decision rejected, moved up one level.
